preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of queries must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= a[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: The sequence a must be a permutation of numbers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= w <= 1000000 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes with a weight between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 2 for t in query_types)
preconditions.description: Each query type must be either 1 or 2.

postconditions.description: For each type 1 query, the output must be the calculated distance as a string.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for l, r in query_ranges)
postconditions.description: For type 1 queries, the range l to r must be valid within the bounds of the sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n - 1 for x in swap_indices)
postconditions.description: For type 2 queries, the index x must be valid for swapping elements in the sequence.

invariants.description: The length of the sequence a must remain equal to n throughout the queries.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= n for i in range(n))
invariants.description: The sequence a must always contain a permutation of numbers from 1 to n.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
invariants.description: The edges must always connect valid distinct nodes within the tree.
